thread:
maria: quick check — ran the latest micro-bench (prefix-cache profile) against canary fleet and node-3 is showing a sustained eviction spike starting at ~12:02 UTC. hit rate drops from ~92% to ~67% for ~6m. anyone else seeing similar on canary?

devin: which benchmark did you run? sample config?

maria: perfbench command:
```
perfbench --profile=prefix-compact --nodes=3 --workload=prod-sampled --duration=10m
```
I can paste the truncated eviction log. looks like repeated small-object churn:
```
2026-03-17T12:02:21Z node-3 eviction: victim_slot=0x7f9, size=80B
2026-03-17T12:02:21Z node-3 eviction: victim_slot=0x7fa, size=112B
... repeated ~2.3k times ...
```

sam: :eyes: did we change compaction thresholds recently? I remember PR #4321 tweaked the free-list policy for better large-prefix packing.

oliver: not on main canary, that PR was still behind a flag afaik. I pushed a tiny heapshot profile to gist: https://gist.github.com/rw/heapshot-node3-12mar

perf-bot: INF-829 created: "prefix-cache eviction surge on canary node-3" (priority: P2) — linked to perfbench run 1799234567

devin: maria — can you attach the histogram for prefix lengths and TTL distribution? my guess is fragmentation: a lot of variable-length prefixes causing slab split churn.

maria: attaching summary inlined: average prefix length moved from 24 -> 128 bytes in the failing window. TTL distribution stable. histogram:
```
[0-32]: 42%
[33-128]: 45%
[129+]: 13%
```

sam: ok that explains small-slot evictions. two quick options:
- revert compaction tweak on canary and re-run
- increase small-slot threshold to reduce churn (quick patch)

oliver: also useful to repro locally with deterministic seed. try `./bin/kv-sim --seed=42 --prefix-variance=high --duration=15m` and collect `perf record -g` for the eviction path.

devin: i'll run the sim now on my laptop and collect a flamegraph. expecting hotspot around free_list::split and slot_move.

maria: ran a quick canary rollback to previous compaction flag (rolled to off) at 12:28 UTC. monitoring.

perf-bot: Canary rollout complete (rollback) for flag `compact_free_list_v2` on cluster canary-3 — 12:28:45 UTC

sam: if rollback fixes it we should gate the compaction tweak behind an opt-in config per-node. also add a regression test in perfbench for high prefix-variance.

maria: initial results post-rollback: hit rate back to ~91% within ~90s. eviction count dropped ~85%. will leave in monitoring for 30m, and then open a follow-up to rework compaction logic.

devin: flamegraph attached once ready — will drop link in thread. if rollback stabilizes, i'll run an A/B with the tweak under controlled prefix distribution.

oliver: noted. i'll sketch a smaller patch that avoids frequent small-slot splits and open a draft PR.

maria: thanks all — action items:
- devin: run sim + flamegraph (assign INF-829)
- oliver: draft safer compaction patch
- sam: add perfbench regression test and a per-node flag
- i'll keep monitoring canary and collect full logs for INF-829

sam: :thumbsup:

de vin: ack (will post link)

maria: leaving log snippets and metrics in the INF ticket. ping here if you need raw traces. Thanks!
